narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this session, we'll embark on an exciting journey to understand how living organisms manage their internal functions and respond to the world around them. We'll explore the fascinating mechanisms of control and coordination in both plants and animals. By the end of this lesson, you will be able to: Define control and coordination and understand their significance. Explore the animal nervous and endocrine systems. Understand reflex actions and the reflex arc. Delve into the structure and functions of the human brain. Discover coordination and hormones in plants. And finally, examine the crucial role of hormones in animals.
